newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabwe's Mugabe appoints new education minister.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwe's Mugabe appoints new education minister.

text.p: Zimbabwean parliamentarian Gabriel Machinga has been appointed education minister, filling a vacancy left by Edmund Garwe who resigned last December over an examination paper leak, a government statement said on Tuesday.
Machinga was also national affairs, employment creation and co-operatives deputy minister. His successor has yet to be named.
Garwe resigned after six months in office after admitting that his daughter took an examination paper which he had taken home.
